label: PF Backlog 467
title: Update /wg command docs for ADR-0003/BI-PF-0423 (work=worker, claim-only, status=PF assignments)
body:
Source: user verification of the command surfaces (2026-10-07).

DRIFT: the `/wg` CLI (workergrid/wg.py) has the 0423 behavior (/wg work = the worker; --claim-only; /wg status =
PF assignments; agent PF mode per ADR-0003), and /pf correctly has no worker verbs, BUT the `/wg` command docs
(.opencode/command/wg.md, .opencode/command_global/wg.md, installed ~/.config/opencode/command/wg.md) still
describe `/wg work` as claim-only and omit the thin-client/PF model.

Fix: update the `/wg` verb map + NOTE in all three copies (project + global + installed, byte-identical) to
reflect ADR-0003: WorkerGrid = thin runtime host; PF owns assignment + delivery; `/wg work` = the worker
(loop/--once; --claim-only = claim only); `/wg status` = PF GET /engineering/assignments; coordinator =
fallback; two planes (worker = product_forge only).

dashboard_impact: no UI surface.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS; wg-surface OK; installed wg.md byte-identical. Updated the /wg verb map + NOTE (all 3 copies) for ADR-0003: work=worker, --claim-only, status=PF assignments, contract, two planes. /pf already had no worker verbs (pf-surface OK).

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/run_status.py, core/status.py, core/test_framework_bridge.py
